headline: BSF shoots Bangladeshi man killed at Thakurgaon border
summary: A 35-year-old man from Pirganj was killed by the Indian Border Security Force (BSF) inside Indian territory, while two others were detained.

caption:
A Bangladeshi man was killed by BSF fire at the Thakurgaon border. Two others were detained.

A 35-year-old Bangladeshi man, Ashadul Haq, was killed by the Indian Border Security Force (BSF) on Saturday morning, September 12, inside Indian territory.

The incident occurred near the Radhikapur camp of the BSF in the Kaliyaganj police station area of North Dinajpur district, India.

Two other Bangladeshis, Mustakin (38) and Uda Chandra Roy (35), were detained by the BSF and handed over to the Kaliyaganj police station.

Lt. Col. Abdullah Al Moin Hussain, commander of the 42 BGB battalion, BGB soldiers up to now have not received detailed information regarding the incident.

Officer-in-Charge (OC) of Pirganj police station, Iqbal Hossain Pramanik, said he had heard of the death of a Bangladeshi man through Indian media reports.

Information regarding the return of the deceased's body to Bangladesh has not yet been known.

headline: 10 Bangladeshis taken to India after boat capsizes in Padma
summary: The individuals were rescued from the river after a boat accident involving Bangladeshi owns citizens.
details: Ten Bangladeshi citizens were taken to India for medical treatment or rescue operations following a boat capsizing incident in the Padma river.
The accident occurred in the Padma river, a major waterway that forms part of the border between Bangladesh and Bangladesh's neighbor India.
The rescue operations were carried out to ensure the safety of the people involved in the accident.
The rescuees were taken across the border into India to facilitate immediate assistance and medical care.
